settings.name: USE_ACME
settings.description: Enable ACME certificate management for this service using a custom ACME-compatible Certificate Authority.

settings.name: ACME_PASSTHROUGH
settings.description: Pass through only GET/HEAD requests for one token-shaped ACME HTTP-01 URI to the upstream. That request skips antibot, blacklist, request-rate limiting, Basic Auth, ModSecurity, and the ban check; NGINX connection limits (limit_conn) still apply.

settings.name: ACME_DIRECTORY_URL
settings.description: ACME directory URL of the Certificate Authority (e.g. https://ca.example.com/acme/directory for Step CA, https://vault.example.com/v1/pki/acme/directory for Vault PKI).

settings.name: ACME_EMAIL
settings.description: Email address for ACME account registration and notifications.

settings.name: ACME_EAB_KID
settings.description: External Account Binding Key ID (required by some CAs like Sectigo, Google Trust Services).

settings.name: ACME_EAB_HMAC_KEY
settings.description: External Account Binding HMAC key (base64-encoded, required when EAB Key ID is set).

settings.name: ACME_CA_CERT_PATH
settings.description: File path to the root CA certificate for private ACME servers (Step CA, Vault PKI). Required when the CA root is not in the system trust store.

settings.name: ACME_CHALLENGE
settings.description: ACME challenge type. HTTP-01 is simplest; DNS-01 is required for wildcard certificates; TLS-ALPN-01 works when port 80 is unavailable.

settings.name: ACME_DNS_PROVIDER
settings.description: DNS provider for DNS-01 challenges.

settings.name: ACME_DNS_CREDENTIAL_ITEM
settings.description: Configuration item for the DNS provider credentials (e.g. 'cloudflare_api_token 123456'). Values can be base64 encoded.

settings.name: ACME_DNS_CREDENTIAL_DECODE_BASE64
settings.description: Automatically decode base64 encoded DNS provider credentials.

settings.name: ACME_DNS_PROPAGATION
settings.description: Seconds to wait for DNS propagation before the CA validates a DNS-01 challenge. 'default' applies a safe 120s wait (except route53, which polls until synced); set a number to override. Raise it if your provider is slow to publish TXT records.

settings.name: ACME_DNS_ALIAS
settings.description: Target zone for DNS-01 CNAME delegation. ACME PRO writes a per-cert domain alias JSON map and passes it to certbot with --dns-<provider>-domain-aliases-file, so DNS credentials only need to control the alias zone. Prerequisite: each cert domain must already have a CNAME `_acme-challenge.<domain>` -> `_acme-challenge.<target>` (and the target zone must resolve). Example: 'alias.acmeplay.org'. Silently ignored on older runtimes or with incompatible DNS providers (e.g. route53).

settings.name: ACME_KEY_TYPE
settings.description: Key type for the certificate. ECDSA is smaller and faster; RSA has broader compatibility.

settings.name: ACME_KEY_SIZE
settings.description: Key size in bits. For ECDSA: 256 or 384. For RSA: 2048 or 4096.

settings.name: ACME_PREFERRED_CHAIN
settings.description: Preferred certificate chain issuer CN. Selects the preferred chain when the CA provides multiple.

settings.name: ACME_RENEWAL_DAYS
settings.description: Renew the certificate when it has fewer than this many days until expiry.

settings.name: ACME_SSL_VERIFY
settings.description: Verify SSL certificates when communicating with the ACME server. Disable only for testing with self-signed CA certs.

settings.name: ACME_WILDCARD
settings.description: Request wildcard certificate (requires DNS-01 challenge). The base domain is the parent of each server name, so www.example.com yields example.com and *.example.com.

settings.name: ACME_DISABLE_PUBLIC_SUFFIXES
settings.description: Refuse certificate requests for domains matching the Public Suffix List (recommended, default: yes).

settings.name: ACME_MUST_STAPLE
settings.description: Request the OCSP Must-Staple extension in the certificate.

settings.name: ACME_MAX_RETRIES
settings.description: Number of times to retry certificate generation on failure (0 disables retries).

settings.name: USE_ACME_MONITORING
settings.description: Enable certificate expiry monitoring and status tracking for all managed certificates (including OSS Let's Encrypt certificates).

settings.name: ACME_ALERT_DAYS
settings.description: Space-separated list of day thresholds that trigger expiry alerts.

settings.name: USE_ACME_ALERT_WEBHOOK
settings.description: Send certificate alerts via webhook.

settings.name: ACME_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URLS
settings.description: Space-separated list of webhook URLs for certificate alerts.

settings.name: USE_ACME_ALERT_EMAIL
settings.description: Send certificate alerts via email.

settings.name: ACME_ALERT_SMTP_EMAILS
settings.description: Space-separated list of email recipients for certificate alerts.

settings.name: ACME_ALERT_SMTP_HOST
settings.description: SMTP host for certificate alert emails.

settings.name: ACME_ALERT_SMTP_PORT
settings.description: SMTP port for certificate alert emails (SSL=465, TLS=587).

settings.name: ACME_ALERT_SMTP_FROM_EMAIL
settings.description: Sender email address for certificate alerts.

settings.name: ACME_ALERT_SMTP_FROM_USER
settings.description: SMTP authentication user for certificate alert emails.

settings.name: ACME_ALERT_SMTP_FROM_PASSWORD
settings.description: SMTP authentication password for certificate alert emails.

settings.name: ACME_ALERT_SMTP_SSL
settings.description: Connection type for certificate alert SMTP.

settings.name: USE_ACME_CT_MONITORING
settings.description: Enable Certificate Transparency log monitoring. Queries crt.sh to detect unauthorized certificate issuance for your domains.

settings.name: ACME_CT_MONITORED_DOMAINS
settings.description: Space-separated list of domains to monitor in CT logs. Leave empty to auto-detect from configured services.

settings.name: USE_ACME_OCSP_STAPLING
settings.description: Enable enhanced OCSP stapling with proactive response fetching and caching.

settings.name: ACME_OCSP_CACHE_SIZE
settings.description: Size of the shared dictionary for OCSP response caching.
